articles.summary: TL;DR A SAFE gives an investor a contractual right to receive equity after a specified future event. The investor does not receive stock when signing, and a SAFE generally does not operate as debt. Weak signing controls can produce mismatched versions, missing countersignatures, incorrect investor details, and incomplete records even when the terms are correct.
